title: aw-slices
source: #55: on a cleared map, the deliverable is planned before it is built
command: /ai-workflow:aw-slices reserve-book, en una sola slice: el entregable es pequeño

answers.when: How to split the work, or whether to approve the slice plan it proposes
answers.intent: One slice, the whole deliverable, since it is small: approve a plan that already has one slice, and otherwise ask for one, typed in if it is not an option
answers.reason: keeps the case to one build

answers.when: Which test seam to use, or whether to accept the one it proposes
answers.reason: the build needs one agreed seam, and the case does not test which

turns.intent: Accept the slice plan and the test strategy

assertions.judge: Filled in the slice plan and Test strategy without touching the map
